metadata.title: Rewards Store | HabitParty
metadata.description: Redeem your gold coins for custom rewards, time vouchers, and mystery boxes.

SingleUse.title: Single-Use — No timer required
SingleUse.descriptionGamified: Best for one-off treats (e.g., coffee, takeout, a purchase). Consumed in 1 click from your Backpack.
SingleUse.descriptionProductivity: Best for one-off treats (e.g., coffee, takeout, a purchase). Consumed in 1 click from your Inventory.

TimeBased.title: Time Voucher — Tracked in Focus timer
TimeBased.descriptionGamified: Best for timed leisure (e.g., 1h of gaming, TV episode). Stored in your Backpack and counts down in Focus.
TimeBased.descriptionProductivity: Best for timed leisure (e.g., 1h of gaming, TV episode). Stored in your Inventory and counts down in Focus.

MysteryBox.title: Mystery Box — Roulette draw
MysteryBox.description: Lootbox with 3 prizes of varying odds (Common, Rare, and Jackpot) drawn on a roulette wheel in your Backpack.
MysteryBox.descriptionProductivity: Weighted roulette with 3 break/treat outcomes (Frequent, Mid-Tier, and Top Reward) drawn in your Inventory.

formModal.debtToggleSubtitle: Direct settlement: deducts coins right away without sending to Backpack.
formModal.debtToggleSubtitleProductivity: Direct settlement: deducts credits right away without sending to Inventory.
formModal.debtTooltipAria: Learn what Debt mode is for
formModal.debtTooltipBody: Use this when you go over a leisure time limit or indulge in an urgent distraction before earning enough coins.
formModal.debtTooltipPointDirect: Clicking Pay Debt deducts coins and settles it immediately without creating a Backpack item.
formModal.debtTooltipPointDirectProductivity: Clicking Pay Debt deducts credits and settles it immediately without creating an Inventory item.
formModal.debtTooltipPointExample: Does not count as a reward redemption for achievements and can be filtered later until settled.
formModal.debtTooltipPointExampleProductivity: Remains easy to filter so you can settle it as soon as you earn enough credits.
formModal.durationHint: (time that will be consumed in Focus)
formModal.multiPackageToggleHint: Grouped into a single showcase card
formModal.multiPackagePreviewTitle: Will create {count} packages on the same card:
formModal.multiPackagePreviewHint: In the showcase, click any chip (30m, 1h, 3h...) to switch package before buying.
formModal.debtUnitPricingTooltipTitle: Why does Debt use unit pricing?
formModal.debtUnitPricingTooltipBody: Debts remain fixed in the showcase without combo discounts (so higher packages never cost less per unit). Use the inline card multiplier (− 1x +) when settling.
formModal.mysteryBoxPriceHelper: You can keep the calibrated price for the package or customize it freely.
formModal.singleUseTiersTooltipBody: Calibrated horizon (~15 coins = 1 productive day): Treat (4) = quick break; Daily (15) = 1 consistent day; Weekly (50) = weekly reward; Milestone (150) = ~10-day goal. Choose None for custom pricing.

effort.mediumTasks: ~{count, plural, one {# Medium task} other {# Medium tasks}}

warnings.belowCalibrated: Well below the calibrated {price} coins — too easy to farm and may reduce the sense of achievement.
warnings.aboveCalibrated: Over 2× the calibrated {price} coins — watch out for frustration or burnout.
warnings.singleUseTooLow: Very low cost — trivial rewards can quickly lose motivational impact.
warnings.singleUseTooHigh: Long-horizon milestone — consider splitting into intermediate rewards to avoid frustration.
warnings.belowCalibratedProductivity: Well below the calibrated price ({price} credits) — may be too easy and reduce break value.
warnings.aboveCalibratedProductivity: More than double the calibrated price ({price} credits) — avoid overpricing routine recovery.

BASIC.name: Basic Box
BASIC.subtitle: Daily Breaks & Quick Treats
BASIC.concept: Micro-rewards to keep your momentum guilt-free without unbalancing your coins.

0.label: Refreshing Break (10m)
0.description: Specialty coffee, favorite snack, or a short guilt-free break.

1.label: Medium Leisure Voucher (20m)
1.description: Leisure reading, 1 short video, relaxing music, or a podcast.

2.label: Focused Hobby Session (40m)
2.description: 40 minutes dedicated to your favorite hobby.

PREMIUM.name: Premium Box
PREMIUM.subtitle: Entertainment & Gaming Session
PREMIUM.concept: A reward for one or two days of goals completed with excellence.

0.label: Standard Leisure (35m)
0.description: Quick gaming session or 1 series/anime episode.

1.label: Extended Leisure Voucher (60m)
1.description: 1 full hour of entertainment or a celebratory special snack.

EPIC.name: Epic Box
EPIC.subtitle: Big Weekly Achievement
EPIC.concept: A substantial weekend reward to crown consistent days.

0.label: Extended Leisure Block (90m)
0.description: 1h 30m of favorite games, binge-watching, or an outdoor outing.

1.label: Full Free Evening (150m)
1.description: 2h 30m free or a book/game on sale.

2.label: Full Afternoon Unplugged (240m)
2.description: 4 hours of well-deserved rest and a full energy recharge.

LEGENDARY.name: Legendary Box
LEGENDARY.subtitle: The Holy Grail of Productivity
LEGENDARY.concept: The pinnacle of weeks of discipline and unbroken streaks. A memorable milestone.

0.label: Elite Partial Day-Off (180m)
0.description: 3 hours dedicated to your hobbies with duty fulfilled.

1.label: Extended Day-Off (360m)
1.description: 6 hours off for rest, leisure, or a personal project.

2.label: Ultimate Celebration (Supreme Jackpot)
2.description: Free weekend + permission for a major real-life treat.
